For a two-hour commute, the train is usually the cheapest reliable option.

| Option | Cost per trip | Time | Reliability |
|---|---|---|---|
| Train | Low | 2 h | High |
| Car | Medium | 1.5 h | Depends on traffic |
| Coach | Lowest | 2.5 h | Medium |

The car wins only when you travel outside peak hours, because traffic decides its time.
